questions.question: What is the LCM of a 3 b - ab 3 , a 3 b 2 - a 2 b 3 , ab(a - b)?

options.html: a2b2(a2 - b2)
a2b3(a2 + b2)
a3b2(a2 - b2)

questions.solution:
x = a3b – ab3 = ab(a2 – b2) = ab(a – b)(a + b)

y = a3b2 – a2b3 = a2b2(a – b)

z = ab(a – b)

⇒ LCM = a2b2(a + b)(a – b) = a2b2(a2 – b2)

questions.question: The sides of a triangular field are 62 m, 186 m and 279 m. Find the greatest length of tape that would be able to exactly measure each of them without any fractions.
questions.questionHtml: The sides of a triangular field are 62 m, 186 m and 279 m. Find the greatest length of tape that would be able to exactly measure each of them without any fractions.
questions.solution:
Prime factors of 62 = (2 x 31), 186 = (2 x 3 x 31) and 279 = (3 x 3 x 31)

Then HCF of (62, 186, 279) = 31, so the greatest length of tape that would be able to exactly measure each of them without any fractions = 31 m

questions.question: What is the sum of digits of the least number, which when divided by 15, 18 and 42 leaves the same remainder 8 in each case and is also divisible by 13?
questions.questionHtml: What is the sum of digits of the least number, which when divided by 15, 18 and 42 leaves the same remainder 8 in each case and is also divisible by 13?
questions.solution:
L.C.M = 2 × 3 × 3 × 5 × 7 = 630

First of all find the LCM of 15, 18 and 42 and as it leaves remainder of 8, then the number is LCM + 8.

15 = 3 × 5

18 = 2 × 3 × 3

42 = 2 × 3 × 7

LCM = 2 × 3 × 3 × 5 × 7

LCM = 630

The number can be 630 + 8 = 638

But the condition is, the number should also be completely divisible by 13

Let multiply in 630 by x, so number become (630x + 8). So, this number should be divisible by 13, so we find out the value of x

According to the question

(630x + 8) ÷ 13

630x/13 + 8/13

(48x × 13 + 6x)/13 + 8/13

(48x × 13)/13 + (6x + 8)/13

(6x + 8) divisible by 13 so, we put x = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7… so that number become divisible by 13.

When we put x = 3, then number become (6 × 3 + 8) = 26 which is divisible by 13, so x = 3

630x + 8

630 × 3 + 8

1890 + 8

1898

Sum the digit of the number 1898 is = 1 + 8 + 9 + 8 = 26

questions.question: LCM of two number is 22 times their HCF. If one of the numbers is 132 and the sum of LCM and HCF is 276, then what is the other number?
questions.questionHtml: LCM of two number is 22 times their HCF. If one of the numbers is 132 and the sum of LCM and HCF is 276, then what is the other number?
questions.solution:
22h + h = 276 ⇒ h = \(276\over 23\) = 12

⇒ LCM = 12 × 22 = 264

Using LCM × HCF = One number × Other number

12 × 264 = 132 × Other Number ⇒ Other number = 12 × 264 ÷ 132 = 24

questions.question: Which of the following statement is true?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following statement is true?

options.text: LCM of two natural numbers is divisible by their HCF
options.html: LCM of two natural numbers is divisible by their HCF

options.text: HCF + LCM of two number = Product of the two numbers
options.html: HCF + LCM of two number = Product of the two numbers

options.text: Two prime numbers are co-prime numbers if their LCM is 1
options.html: Two prime numbers are co-prime numbers if their LCM is 1

options.text: HCF of two numbers is the smallest common divisor of both numbers.
options.html: HCF of two numbers is the smallest common divisor of both numbers.

questions.solution:
HCF is the factor of any two or more numbers, which are common among them and hence is not the smallest common divisor of both numbers.

Example: Let us take two numbers 4 & 6 

4 = 2 × 2, 6 = 2 × 3

HCF = 2 not divisible by 4 & 6

 LCM of two natural numbers (Least Common Divisor of Numbers)

LCM = 2 × 2 × 3 = 12  divide by 2(HCF of 4 & 6) also  

Hence, The LCM of two natural numbers is divisible by their HCF.

questions.question: How many numbers between 400 and 700 are divisible by 5, 6 and 7?
questions.questionHtml: How many numbers between 400 and 700 are divisible by 5, 6 and 7?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

L.C.M of 5,6 and 7 = 210

The first number divisible by 210 between 400 and 700 is 420.

The last number divisible by 210 between 400 and 700 is 630.

Tn = a + (n - 1) d

⇒ 630 = 420 + (n - 1) 210

⇒ 210 = (n - 1) 210

⇒ (n - 1) = 1

⇒ n = 2

Alternate Method:

L.C.M of 5,6 and 7 = 210

Quotient on dividing 400 by 210 = 1

Quotient on dividing 700 by 210 = 3

Hence, 3 - 1 = 2

∴ 2 is the answer.

questions.question: Find the HCF of 125, 250 and 750.
questions.questionHtml: Find the HCF of 125, 250 and 750.
questions.solution:
Given:

125, 250, 750

Calculation:

125 = 53

250 = 2 × 53

750 = 2 × 3 × 53

HCF is the product of the smallest power of common primes:

HCF = 53 = 125

∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.

questions.question: What is the sum of the greatest three-digit number and the smallest four-digit number that their HCF is 23?
questions.questionHtml: What is the sum of the greatest three-digit number and the smallest four-digit number that their HCF is 23?
questions.solution:
As we know,

Smallest four-digit number is = 1000

So, the greatest three-digit number which is divisible by 23 = 1000 – 11 = 989

So, the smallest four-digit number which is divisible by 23 = 1000 + 12 = 1012

∴ Required sum of the two number is = 989 + 1012 = 2001

Alternate Method The greatest 3-digit number is 999

When 999 is divided by 23, the remainder is 10

So, the greatest 3-digit number which is divisible by 23,

⇒ (999 - 10) = 989

Now, the smallest 4-digit number is 1000

When 1000 is divided by 23, the remainder is 11

So, the smallest 4-digit number which is divisible by 23,

⇒ 1000 + (23 - 11) = 1012

⇒ Sum = 989 + 1012 = 2001

∴ The correct answer is 2001.

questions.question: What is the greatest positive integer that divides 554, 714 and 213 leaving the remainder 43, 57 and 67, respectively?
questions.questionHtml: What is the greatest positive integer that divides 554, 714 and 213 leaving the remainder 43, 57 and 67, respectively?
questions.solution:
Given:

Integers 554, 714 and 213 

Concept Used:

HCF = Highest Common Factor

Calculation:

⇒ According to the question,

⇒ If the integer leaves remainder 43, on dividing 554, then it divides 511 exactly

⇒ If the integer leaves remainder 57, on dividing 714, then it divides 657 exactly

⇒ If the integer leaves remainder 67, on dividing 213, then it divides 146 exactly

⇒ On prime factorizing 511, 657 and 146, we have 

⇒ 511 = 7 × 73

⇒ 657 = 3 × 3 × 73

⇒ 146 = 2 × 73

⇒ HCF of 511, 657 and 146 = 73

Therefore, the greatest positive integer that divides 554, 714 and 213 leaving the remainder 43, 57 and 67, respectively is 73.

questions.question: The LCM of two numbers is five times their HCF. If the product of the two numbers is 20480,then find their HCF and LCM, respectively.
questions.questionHtml: The LCM of two numbers is five times their HCF. If the product of the two numbers is 20480,then find their HCF and LCM, respectively.
questions.solution:
Given:

LCM of two numbers = 5 × HCF

Product of the two numbers = 20480

Formula used:

LCM(A, B) × HCF(A, B) = A × B (This is because LCM × HCF = Product of the numbers)

Calculation:

Let's denote the HCF as H and the two numbers as A and B. Then:

A × B = 20480

Using formula,

LCM = 5 × HCF

From above, we get:

LCM × HCF = 20480

(5 × HCF) × HCF = 20480

5 × HCF2 = 20480

HCF2 = 20480 / 5

HCF2 = 4096

So, HCF (Highest Common Factor) = √(4096) = 64.

Since LCM = 5 × HCF, LCM = 5 × 64 = 320.

Therefore, their HCF is 64 and LCM is 320.

questions.question: LCM of two numbers is 56 times their HCF, with the sum of their HCF and LCM being 1710. If one of the two numbers is 240, then what is the other number?
questions.questionHtml: LCM of two numbers is 56 times their HCF, with the sum of their HCF and LCM being 1710. If one of the two numbers is 240, then what is the other number?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Given LCM = 56 × HCF and LCM + HCF = 1710.

Total parts = 56 + 1 = 57 parts = 1710 ⇒ 1 part (HCF) = 30.

LCM = 56 × 30 = 1680.

Using the property: First Number × Second Number = HCF × LCM

Other number = (30 × 1680) ÷ 240 = 210.

∴ The correct answer is 210.

Alternate Method

Given:

LCM = 56 × HCF

LCM + HCF = 1710

One number (N1) = 240

Formula Used:

LCM × HCF = N1 × N2

Calculations:

⇒ Let HCF = H

⇒ LCM = 56H

⇒ 56H + H = 1710

⇒ 57H = 1710

⇒ H = 1710 ÷ 57 = 30

⇒ HCF = 30

⇒ LCM = 56 × 30 = 1680

⇒ N1 × N2 = HCF × LCM

⇒ 240 × N2 = 30 × 1680

⇒ N2 = (30 × 1680) ÷ 240

⇒ N2 = 30 × 7

⇒ N2 = 210

∴ The correct answer is 210.

Additional Information

Product of Two Numbers

For any two positive integers a and b, the product of the numbers is equal to the product of their HCF and LCM: a × b = HCF × LCM.

Co-prime Factors

If two numbers are expressed as H × x and H × y (where H is the HCF), then x and y are always co-prime to each other. Their LCM is formed by H × x × y.

LCM Divisibility

The LCM of a given set of numbers is always perfectly divisible by their HCF. Dividing the LCM by the HCF will always leave a remainder of 0.

questions.question: The LCM of two numbers is 168 and their HCF is 12. If the difference between the numbers is 60, what is the sum of the numbers?
questions.questionHtml: The LCM of two numbers is 168 and their HCF is 12. If the difference between the numbers is 60, what is the sum of the numbers?
questions.solution:
Given∶

LCM of two numbers = 168

HCF of two numbers = 12

Difference of two numbers = 60

Calculation∶

Let two numbers be a and b be respectively.

Formula∶ Product of two numbers = Product of LCM and HCF of two numbers

⇒ a × b = 168 × 12

⇒ ab = 2016      ----(1)

a – b = 60      ----(2)

Formula∶ (a + b)2 – (a – b)2 = 4ab

Put the value of (1) and (2) into above expression,

⇒ (a + b)2 – (60)2 = 4 × 2016

⇒ (a + b)2 = 8064 + 3600 = 11664

⇒ a + b = 108

questions.question: What is the sum of the digits of the least number which when divided by 15, 18 and 36 leaves the same remainder 9 in each case and is divisible by 11 ?
questions.questionHtml: What is the sum of the digits of the least number which when divided by 15, 18 and 36 leaves the same remainder 9 in each case and is divisible by 11 ?
questions.solution:
Given:

The number when divided by 15, 18 and 36 and leaves the same remainder 9.

The number is also divisible by 11.

Calculations:

The least number which will be completely divisible by the 15, 18 and 36 will be the LCM of 15, 18 and 36.

⇒ LCM of 15, 18 and 36 = 180

The least number will be completely divisible by the 15, 18 and 36 and leaves remainder 9 = 180k + 9

Where,

k = natural number

when k = 1

⇒ 189

Here 189 is not divisible by 11.

When k = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5. The number is not divisible by 11.

Now, k = 6

Number = 180 × 6 + 9

⇒ Number = 1089

The number 1089 is divisible by 11.

Sum of digits = 1 + 0 + 8 + 9

⇒ 18

∴ The sum of the digits of the least number which when divided by 15, 18 and 36 leaves the same remainder 9 in each case and is divisible by 11 is 18.

Let multiply in 432 by x, so number become (432x + 7). So this number should be divisible by 13, so we find out the value of x

(432x + 7) ÷ 13

= 432x/13 + 7/13

= (33x × 13 + 3x)/13 + 7/13

questions.question: What is the LCM of 3.6, 1.8 and 0.144?
questions.questionHtml: What is the LCM of 3.6, 1.8 and 0.144?
questions.solution:
Given data:

Number = 3.6, 1.8, and 0.144

Calculation:

Digit with highest digits after decimal = 0.144 

⇒ 3 digits after decimal i.e., n = 3 = 103 

⇒ 3.6 × 103 = 3600

⇒ 1.8 × 103 = 1800

⇒ 0.144 × 103 = 144

Finding the LCM of (3600, 1800, 144) = 3600

LCM = \({3600\over 10^3}= 3.6\)

∴ The LCM of the given numbers is 3.6.

Alternate MethodThe LCM of 3.6, 1.8 and 0.144

LCM of (3.6, 1.8, 0.144)

⇒ LCM of (3600/1000, 1800/1000, 144/1000)

⇒ LCM of (3600/1000, 1800/1000, 144/1000) = \(\frac{LCM of (3600, 1800, 144)}{HCF of (1000, 1000, 1000)}\)

⇒ 3600/1000 = 3.6

∴ The LCM of the given numbers is 3.6.

questions.question: The highest common factor of 108, 72 and 5a is a. What can be the least common multiple of 108, 72 and a?
questions.questionHtml: The highest common factor of 108, 72 and 5a is a. What can be the least common multiple of 108, 72 and a?
questions.solution:
Given:

HCF of 108, 72 and 5a = a

Calculation:

⇒ 108 = 72 × 1 + 36

⇒ 72 = 36 × 2 + 0

⇒ Third number = 5a = 5 × 36 = 180

⇒ Now, we got a = 36

⇒ 108 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 × 3

⇒ 72 = 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 3

⇒ 36 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 3

⇒ LCM of 108, 72 and 36 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 3 × 3 × 2 = 216

Therefore, the LCM of 108, 72 and a is 216, where a is 36.

questions.question: Let x be the least 4–digit number which when divided by 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7 leaves a remainder of 1 in each case. If x lies between 2800 and 3000, then what is the sum of the digits of x?
questions.questionHtml: Let x be the least 4–digit number which when divided by 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 7 leaves a remainder of 1 in each case. If x lies between 2800 and 3000, then what is the sum of the digits of x?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

The LCM of given divisors 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, and 7 is 420.

The required number x leaving a remainder of 1 will be in the form (420k + 1).

For k = 7, the number x = 420 × 7 + 1 = 2941, which perfectly lies between 2800 and 3000.

Sum of the digits of x = 2 + 9 + 4 + 1 = 16.

∴ The correct answer is 16.

Alternate Method

Given:

Divisors = 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, and 7

Remainder = 1 in each case

Range of number x = Between 2800 and 3000

Formula Used:

Number = LCM(Divisors) × k + Remainder

Calculation:

⇒ First, calculate the LCM of 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, and 7.

⇒ LCM(2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7) = 420

⇒ Let the required number be x = 420k + 1

⇒ According to the given condition: 2800 < 420k + 1 < 3000

⇒ Subtracting 1 from all parts: 2799 < 420k < 2999

⇒ Dividing by 420: 6.66 < k < 7.14

⇒ Since k must be a whole integer, the only possible value for k is 7.

⇒ Substitute k = 7 into the equation for x:

⇒ x = 420 × 7 + 1

⇒ x = 2940 + 1 = 2941

⇒ Now, find the sum of the digits of x (2941).

⇒ Sum of digits = 2 + 9 + 4 + 1 = 16

∴ The correct answer is 16.

Additional Information

LCM Rule for Same Remainder

When a number is divided by a, b, and c leaving the same remainder r in each case, the general form of the number is given by [LCM(a, b, c) × k] + r.

LCM Rule for Different Remainders

If divided by a, b, and c leaving remainders x, y, and z respectively such that the difference is constant (a − x = b − y = c − z = d), the number format is [LCM(a, b, c) × k] − d.

HCF Rule for Same Remainder

The greatest number dividing a, b, and c and leaving the same remainder r in each case is given by HCF(a − r, b − r, c − r).

questions.question: If P(x) = (x 3 - 8)(x + 1) and Q(x) = (x 3 + 1)(x - 2) the LCM of P(x) and Q(x) is:
questions.questionHtml: If P(x) = (x<sup>3</sup> - 8)(x + 1) and Q(x) = (x<sup>3</sup> + 1)(x - 2) the LCM of P(x) and Q(x) is:

options.html: (x2 + 2x + 4)(x2 + 4x + 1)
(x + 1)(x - 2)(x2 + 2x + 4)(x2 - x + 1)
(x + 1)2 (x - 2)2 (x2 + 2x + 4)(x2 + 4x + 1)

questions.solution:
Formula used:

a³ - b³ = (a - b)(a² + ab + b²)

a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² - ab + b²)

Calculations:

P(x) = (x3 - 8)(x + 1)

⇒ P(x) = (x - 2)(x2 + 2x + 4)(x + 1) 

 Q(x) = (x3 + 1)(x - 2)

⇒ Q(x) = (x + 1)(x2 - x + 1(x - 2)

Now, The LCM of P(x) and Q(x) is

(x + 1)(x - 2)(x2 + 2x + 4)(x2 - x + 1)

Hence, The Required value is (x + 1)(x - 2)(x2 + 2x + 4)(x2 - x + 1).

questions.question: The LCM of x 2 - 8x + 15 and x 2 - 5x + 6 is:
questions.questionHtml: The LCM of x<sup>2</sup> - 8x + 15 and x<sup>2</sup> - 5x + 6 is:

options.html: (x - 2)(x - 3)2(x - 5)

questions.solution:
⇒ x2 - 8x + 15 = \(x^2 -5x-3x+15\) = \(x(x-5)-3(x-5)\) = (x - 5) (x - 3)

⇒ x2 - 5x + 6 = \(x^2 -3x-2x+6\) = x(x-3) -2(x-3) = (x-2) (x-3)

LCM is  (x-5) (x-2) (x-3).

questions.question: Which is the largest six-digit number, which when divided by 12, 15, 20, 24 and 30, leaves the remainders 8, 11, 16, 20 and 26 respectively.
questions.questionHtml: Which is the largest six-digit number, which when divided by 12, 15, 20, 24 and 30, leaves the remainders 8, 11, 16, 20 and 26 respectively.
questions.solution:
LCM of 12, 15, 20, 24, 30 is 120

As we know,

(12 – 8) = (15 – 11) = (20 – 16) = (24 – 20) = (30 – 26) = 4

As we know,

6 digit largest number = 999999

So, number divisible by 120 = 999999 – 39 = 999960

Required number is = 999960 – 4 = 999956

questions.question: The LCM of two prime numbers x and y (x > y) is 533. The value of 4y - x is:
questions.questionHtml: The LCM of two prime numbers x and y (x > y) is 533. The value of 4y - x is:
questions.solution:
Solving: 533 = x × y

Prime factorization of 533 = 13 × 41

So, x = 41 and y = 13 (x > y)

4y - x ⇒ 4(13) - 41 ⇒ 52 - 41 = 11

questions.question: What is the HCF of (x 6 + 1) and (x 4 - 1) ?
questions.questionHtml: What is the HCF of (x6 + 1) and (x4 - 1) ?
questions.solution:
Using formula, (x6 + 1)

= (x2)3 + 13 = (x2 + 1)(x4 + x2 + 1)

And x4 - 1

= (x2)2 - 12 = (x2 - 1)(x2 + 1)

Now, we know HCF is the greatest common factor

As we can see (x2 + 1) is HCF.

questions.question: Let the HCF of m and n be ‘a’ and let n = ab, LCM of m and n is given by:
questions.questionHtml: Let the HCF of m and n be ‘a’ and let n = ab, LCM of m and n is given by:
questions.solution:
HCF of m and n is a, n = ab,

LCM of m and n is given by the formula: LCM(m, n) = (m × n) / HCF(m, n)

HCF of m and n is a, and n = ab,

The formula for LCM becomes: LCM(m, n) = (m × ab) / a

So, LCM(m, n) = bm

questions.question: What is the LCM of (8x 3 + 80x 2 + 200x) and (4x 4 + 16x 3 - 20x 2 )?
questions.questionHtml: What is the LCM of (8x<sup>3</sup> + 80x<sup>2</sup> + 200x) and (4x<sup>4</sup> + 16x<sup>3</sup> - 20x<sup>2</sup>)?
questions.solution:
If we factorise (8x3 + 80x2 + 200x) and (4x4 + 16x3 - 20x2) we get,

8x3 + 80x2 + 200x ⇒ 8x(x2 + 10x + 25) ⇒ 8x(x2 + 5x + 5x + 25) ⇒ 8x(x + 5)(x + 5)

Again, 4x4 + 16x3 - 20x2 ⇒ 4x2 (x2 + 4x - 5) ⇒ 4x2 (x2 - x + 5x - 5) ⇒ 4x2 (x - 1)(x+ 5)

Now, LCM of the two polynomials is 8x2(x + 5)2(x - 1)

questions.question: If the five-digit number 457ab is divisible by 3, 7 and 11, then what is the value of a 2 + b 2 - ab?
questions.questionHtml: If the five-digit number 457ab is divisible by 3, 7 and 11, then what is the value of a<sup>2</sup> + b<sup>2</sup> - ab?
questions.solution:
Given:

The five-digit number 457ab is divisible by 3, 7, and 11.

Concept used:

LCM defines the least number which is exactly divisible by two or more numbers.

Calculation:

LCM (3, 7, 11) = 231

Let us consider the lowest possible values of a,b.

Suppose the given number = 45700 (Where a = b = 0)

Now, when 45700 is divided by 231, the approximate quotient = 45700 ÷ 231 ≈ 197

So, taking the next integer quotient, we will get a multiple of 231.

Hence, the required number = (197 + 1) × 231 = 45738

So, a = 3, b = 8.

a2 + b2 - ab
⇒ 9 + 64 - 24

⇒ 49

∴ The value of a2 + b2 - ab is 49.

questions.question: If the sum of two numbers is 60 and their HCF and LCM are 5 and 60, respectively, then the sum of the reciprocals of the numbers will be:
questions.questionHtml: If the sum of two numbers is 60 and their HCF and LCM are 5 and 60, respectively, then the sum of the reciprocals of the numbers will be:
questions.solution:
Product of numbers ⇒ 5 × 60 = 300

Let the two numbers be A and B.

Sum = A + B = 60, Product = A × B = 300

Sum of reciprocals ⇒ 1/A + 1/B = (A + B) / (A×B) ⇒ 60 / 300 ⇒ 1/5

questions.question: What is the least number of soldiers that can be drawn up in troops of 10, 12, 15, 18 and 20 soldiers, and also in the form of a solid square?
questions.questionHtml: What is the least number of soldiers that can be drawn up in troops of 10, 12, 15, 18 and 20 soldiers, and also in the form of a solid square?
questions.solution:
In this type of problem, we find the LCM of five numbers first and then we look for what makes the LCM a perfect square.

1st term = 10 = 5 × 2

2nd term = 12 = 2 × 2 × 3

3rd term = 15 = 3 × 5

4th term = 18 = 2 × 3 × 3

5th term = 20 = 2 × 2 × 5

Hence, LCM ( 12,10,15,18,20)

⇒  180

Since the LCM= 180 is not a perfect square , we make it a perfect square by multiplying 5 ( which is the least value to be multiplied)

Then 180 × 5 = 900 = 302

Therefore, 900 solider can be drawn up in the form of a square.

LCM of 165, 176, 385 and 495

So, p = 55440/11

∴ the required value of p is 5040.

questions.question: A can run 250 m in 25 sec and B in 30 sec. How many metres start can A give to B in a km race so that the race may end in a dead-heat?
questions.questionHtml: A can run 250 m in 25 sec and B in 30 sec. How many metres start can A give to B in a km race so that the race may end in a dead-heat?
questions.solution:
Given:

A can run 250 m in 25 sec and B in 30 seconds.

Calculations:

A can run 250 m in 25 seconds

⇒A can run 1 km in 100 seconds

Similarly B can run 1 km in 120 seconds

Distance covered by B in extra 20 seconds

= \(\frac{20}{120}×1000\) m

= 500/3

= 166.67 m

Therefore, A beats B by 166.67 m.

For a dead-heat race, A must give B a start of 166.67 m.

questions.question: When 3738, 5659 and 9501 are divided by the greatest possible number x, the remainder in each case is y. what is the sum of x and y?
questions.questionHtml: When 3738, 5659 and 9501 are divided by the greatest possible number x, the remainder in each case is y. what is the sum of x and y?
questions.solution:
Given:-

Three numbers = 3738, 5659, 9501

Concept used:-

HCF(D1,D2,D3) = Greatest number which gives same remainder

Calculation:-

If remainder in each case is the same, then: 

D1 = 5659 – 3738 = 1921

D2 = 9501 – 5659 = 3842

D3 = 9501 – 3738 = 5763

HCF of 1921, 3842 and 5763 = (x) = 1921

When 3738, 5659 and 9501 are divided by 1921,

To find the remainder when 3738, 5659, and 9501 are divided by 1921, we calculate as follows:

For 3738 divided by 1921:

Remainder of 3738 divided by 1921 = 3738 - (floor(3738/1921) × 1921)

floor(3738/1921) = 1

Therefore, the remainder = 3738 - (1 × 1921) = 3738 - 1921 = 1817

For 5659 divided by 1921:

Remainder of 5659 divided by 1921 = 5659 - (floor(5659/1921) × 1921)

floor(5659/1921) = 2

Therefore, the remainder = 5659 - (2 × 1921) = 5659 - 3842 = 1817

For 9501 divided by 1921:

Remainder of 9501 divided by 1921 = 9501 - (floor(9501/1921) × 1921)

floor(9501/1921) = 4

Therefore, the remainder = 9501 - (4 × 1921) = 9501 - 7684 = 1817

So, the remainder when 3738, 5659, and 9501 are divided by 1921 is each 1817.

Remainder (y) = 1817

Now,

x + y = 1921 + 1817 = 3738

questions.question: The sum of two numbers is 1215 and their HCF is 81. If the numbers lie between 500 and 700, then the sum of the reciprocals of the numbers is ______.
questions.questionHtml: The sum of two numbers is 1215 and their HCF is 81. If the numbers lie between 500 and 700, then the sum of the reciprocals of the numbers is ______.
questions.solution:
Let the numbers be 81x and 81y, then

81x + 81y = 1215

x + y = 1215/81

x + y = 15

Possible pair of x + y are = (1, 14), (2, 13) and (4, 11) an (7, 8)

Number should be between 500 and 700, then

x = 7 and y = 8

First number = 81 × 7 = 567

Second number = 81 × 8 = 648

Sum of the reciprocals of the numbers is = 1/567 + 1/648 = 1/81[1/7 + 1/8] = 1/81 × 15/56

= 5/1512

questions.question: A rectangular courtyard is 4m 95cm long and 16m 65cm broad. It is to be paved with the square tiles of the same size. Find the least number of such square tiles required to pave the rectangular courtyard.
questions.questionHtml: A rectangular courtyard is 4m 95cm long and 16m 65cm broad. It is to be paved with the square tiles of the same size. Find the least number of such square tiles required to pave the rectangular courtyard.
questions.solution:
GCD of 495 and 1665 using Euclidean algorithm:

1665 ÷ 495 = 3 rem 180

495 ÷ 180 = 2 rem 135

180 ÷ 135 = 1 rem 45

135 ÷ 45 = 3 rem 0

GCD = 45 cm

Number of tiles = (495 × 1665) / (45 × 45) = 823575 / 2025 = 407

questions.question: The product of two numbers is 6760 and their HCF is 13. How many such pair of numbers can be formed?
questions.questionHtml: The product of two numbers is 6760 and their HCF is 13. How many such pair of numbers can be formed?
questions.solution:
Given∶ Product of the two numbers = 6760

HCF of the two numbers = 13

Calculation∶

Let the two numbers be 13x and 13y.

Product of the two numbers = 13x × 13y = 6760

⇒ xy = 6760/169

⇒ xy = 40

⇒ Pair of (x, y) can be (1, 40), (2, 20), (4, 10), (5, 8).

Pair of (x, y) should be pair of coprime numbers if pair is not coprime then HCF of the two numbers will be changed.

Coprime Numbers are those numbers which have no common factor except 1, such as 3 and 4.

⇒ (2, 20) and (4, 10) both have 2 as common factor so they are not coprime.

⇒ (1, 40), (5, 8) are coprime.

When x = 1, y = 40

⇒ 13x = 13, 13y = 520

⇒ 1st pair = (13, 520)

When x = 5, y = 8

⇒ 13x = 65, 13y = 104

⇒ 2nd pair = (65, 104)                            

∴ There will be two pair.

questions.question: Let x = 224 and,y = 322. If the highest common factor of 23x and a × y is divisible by x and y, then what can be the possible value of a?
questions.questionHtml: Let x = 224 and,y = 322. If the highest common factor of 23x and a × y is divisible by x and y, then what can be the possible value of a?
questions.solution:
Given:

x = 224, y = 322

Calculation:

HCF(Highest Common Factor) of a and b is the highest number that divides a and b exactly leaving the remainder 0.

23 × 224 = a × 322

a = \(\frac{224}{14}\)

a = 16

Hence, the possible value of a is 16.

questions.question: In finding the HCF of two numbers by division method, the quotients are 1, 8 and 2 respectively, and the last divisor is 105. What is the sum of the numbers?
questions.questionHtml: In finding the HCF of two numbers by division method, the quotients are 1, 8 and 2 respectively, and the last divisor is 105. What is the sum of the numbers?
questions.solution:
Detailed Solution:

AS we know,

Dividend = Divisor × quotient + remainder

Last divisor = 105 and quotient = 2

Dividend (c) = 105 × 2 = 210

Now,

Divisor = 210, quotient = 8 and remainder = 105.

Dividend (a) = 210 × 8 + 105 = 1785

Again

Divisor = 1785, quotient = 1 and remainder = 210

Dividend (b) = 1785 × 1 + 210 = 1995

Sum of a and b = 1785 + 1995 = 3780

Short Trick:

The two numbers are a and b

c = 105 × 2 = 210

b = 210 × 8 + 105 = 1785

a = 1785 × 1 + 210 = 1995

a + b = 1785 + 1995 = 3780

questions.question: When 2388, 4309 and 8151 are divided by a certain 3 - digit number, the remainder in each case is the same. The remainder is:
questions.questionHtml: When 2388, 4309 and 8151 are divided by a certain 3 - digit number, the remainder in each case is the same. The remainder is:
questions.solution:
As we know,

4309 – 2388 = 1921

8151 – 4309 = 3842

8151 – 2388 = 5763

HCF of 1921, 3842 and 5763 is 1921.

As we know, 1921 = 17 × 113

So, the three - digit number is 113.

When we divide 2388, 4309 and 8151 by 113 we find remainder 15 in each case.
